[[File:János hebling in his office.jpg|thumb|János Hebling in his office (2021).]]

'''János Hebling''' (in [[Hungarian names|Hungarian]]: Hebling János) is a Hungarian physicist, known for his preliminary works at [[Terahertz radiation|Terahertz]] physics and [[Terahertz spectroscopy and technology|spectroscopy]]. He was born at [[Zirc]] on 9 May 1954<ref name="auto">{{Cite web|title=Köztestületi tagok|url=https://mta.hu/koztestuleti_tagok|access-date=2021-09-15|website=mta.hu|language=hu}}</ref> and currently works as a professor at the Institute of Physics at [[University of Pécs]]<ref>{{Cite web|title=Munkatársak - Dr. Hebling János {{!}} PTE TTK FI|url=http://www.physics.ttk.pte.hu/munkatarsak/hebling|access-date=2021-09-15|website=www.physics.ttk.pte.hu}}</ref> and is an active researcher at the [[Hungarian Academy of Sciences]]<ref name="auto"/> and [[Extreme Light Infrastructure|ELI]].<ref>{{Cite web|title=About Us|url=https://www.eli-alps.hu/en/About-Us/Governance|access-date=2021-09-15|website=www.eli-alps.hu}}</ref>

== Life ==

He graduated from the [[University of Szeged]] in 1978 with a degree in physics and then obtained his doctorate in 1981. He became a candidate of physical sciences in 1992 and defended his doctoral dissertation at the Hungarian Academy of Sciences in 2003.<ref>{{Cite web|title=Dr. Hebling János {{!}} PTE TTK Fizikai Intézet|url=http://www.physics.ttk.pte.hu/mobile/munkatarsak/hebling|access-date=2021-09-27|website=www.physics.ttk.pte.hu}}</ref> Between 2008 and 2018 he was the head of the Institute of Physics at the Faculty of Science of the University of Pécs;<ref>{{Cite web|title=János Hebling - ODT Personal data sheet|url=https://doktori.hu/index.php?menuid=192&lang=EN&sz_ID=4221|access-date=2021-09-27|website=doktori.hu|language=en}}</ref> since 2012 he has been the head of the [[Hungarian Academy of Sciences|MTA]]-[[University of Pécs|PTE]] High Intensity Terahertz Research Group,<ref name=":0">{{Cite web|title=Staff {{!}} Institute of Physics, UP|url=http://www.physics.ttk.pte.hu/en/staff|access-date=2021-09-27|website=www.physics.ttk.pte.hu}}</ref> and since 2013 he has been the head of the PTE Doctoral School of Physics.<ref name=":0" /> He is well known for his preliminary works on [[Terahertz radiation|terahertz]] physics and [[Terahertz spectroscopy and technology|spectroscopy]], [[Laser science|laser physics]], [[nonlinear optics]], production and application of THz pulses and [[Particle accelerator|laser-driven particle accelerators]]. He was awarded the [[Széchenyi Prize]] and the Gábor Dénes prize for his notable contributions in these areas.<ref>{{Cite web|title=Munkatársak - Dr. Hebling János {{!}} PTE TTK FI|url=http://www.physics.ttk.pte.hu/munkatarsak/hebling|access-date=2021-09-27|website=www.physics.ttk.pte.hu}}</ref>

== Notable works ==
* [[Excimer laser]] development and production technique of short light pulses by excimer laser (1978—1987).<ref>{{Cite journal|date=1987-12-15|title=Excimer laser pumped distributed feedback dye laser|url=https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/abs/pii/0030401887902860|journal=Optics Communications|language=en|volume=64|issue=6|pages=539–543|doi=10.1016/0030-4018(87)90286-0|issn=0030-4018|last1=Hebling|first1=J.|bibcode=1987OptCo..64..539H|url-access=subscription}}</ref>
* Production of [[Ultrashort pulse|ultrashort light pulse]] with a mode-synchronized dye laser, its amplification and its application<ref>{{Cite journal|last1=Hebling|first1=J.|last2=Kuhl|first2=J.|date=1989-03-01|title=Generation of femtosecond pulses by traveling-wave amplified spontaneous emission|url=https://www.osapublishing.org/ol/abstract.cfm?uri=ol-14-5-278|journal=Optics Letters|language=EN|volume=14|issue=5|pages=278–280|doi=10.1364/OL.14.000278|pmid=19749894|bibcode=1989OptL...14..278H|issn=1539-4794|url-access=subscription}}</ref>
* The new production technique of ultrashort light pulses with [[Ti-sapphire laser|titanium-sapphire laser]] and [[optical parametric oscillator]] (1988)<ref>{{Cite journal|last=Hebling|first=J.|date=1988-11-01|title=20 ps pulse generation by an excimer laser pumped double self-Q-switched distributed feedback dye laser|url=https://doi.org/10.1007/BF00697348|journal=Applied Physics B|language=en|volume=47|issue=3|pages=267–272|doi=10.1007/BF00697348|bibcode=1988ApPhB..47..267H|s2cid=120707947|issn=1432-0649|url-access=subscription}}</ref>
* From 1998 he has continued studies about the production of THz pulses using ultrashort laser pulses and its application in [[Solid-state physics|solid state physics]], [[biophysics]], the theoretical study of [[optical parametric oscillator]]s, the study of basic optical relations in this frequency regime.
*In 2002 he and his colleagues introduced a technique of velocity matching by pulse front tilting for large area THz-pulse generation <ref>{{Cite journal|last1=Hebling|first1=János|last2=Almási|first2=Gábor|last3=Kozma|first3=Ida Z.|last4=Kuhl|first4=Jürgen|date=2002-10-21|title=Velocity matching by pulse front tilting for large-area THz-pulse generation|url=https://www.osapublishing.org/oe/abstract.cfm?uri=oe-10-21-1161|journal=Optics Express|language=EN|volume=10|issue=21|pages=1161–1166|doi=10.1364/OE.10.001161|pmid=19451975 |bibcode=2002OExpr..10.1161H |issn=1094-4087|doi-access=free}}</ref>
